cc:Work.dc:title: Box - UniversalBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with various options for different styles and lids
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes UniversalBox --x 140 --y 110 --h 60 --thickness 3 --bottom_edge F --vertical_edges 'finger holes' --top_edge f --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes UniversalBox --x --y --h --bottom_edge --vertical_edges --top_edge --reference
